items.title: 和纸拼贴动画插画（washi paper collage）
items.aspectNote: 源条目 3:4，Imagine 用 2:3 Poster。整批除 yishu-31 外都保持 2:3。
items.imaginePrompt:
A single full-bleed vertical 2:3 Japanese washi-paper collage anime illustration — not a diptych, not a photograph, not a washi-tape still-life collage, and not a picture-book scrapbook travel poster. Invent one complete scene — do not ask for a reference photo, and do not use any existing anime, game, or franchise character.

SCENE: a fully clothed adult East Asian woman in a pale peach kimono-style jacket over a cream inner robe, sitting at a low lacquer table by an open shoji window. Afternoon light falls across tatami. A calico cat sits beside a small vase of camellias. A quiet, peaceful, nostalgic storybook moment.

Render EVERYTHING as if it were physically assembled from many layers of carefully cut traditional Japanese colored paper: visible natural fibers, subtle grain, irregular hand-cut edges, overlapping paper silhouettes, and delicate shadows between layers. Harmonious pastel palette, simplified anime character design, expressive but minimal facial features, flat colored shapes, soft natural lighting, charming imperfect handmade details. Beautiful 2D anime proportions, clear silhouettes, balanced composition. Every object, character, and background element must look constructed from textured colored paper, not digitally painted.

No photorealism, no realistic human skin, no glossy digital rendering, no plastic 3D, no smooth vector look, no metallic surfaces, no excessive gradients, no neon cyberpunk colors, no typography, no watermarks, no logos, no cluttered composition.

items.title: 日本先锋漫画 Y2K 原宿封面（16:9）
items.aspectNote: 源条目 16:9，Imagine 用 16:9 Widescreen。生成前先切换，生成后立刻切回 2:3 Poster。
items.imaginePrompt:
A single full-bleed horizontal 16:9 Japanese neo-pop / Y2K Harajuku street-fashion magazine-cover illustration. High visual impact, retro manga mixed with experimental editorial design: lively, humorous, wild, and fashionable. Not a photograph, not 3D, no letterbox bars.

SUBJECT: an original young-adult Japanese-style anime woman — not a real celebrity and not any existing anime or game character. Silver-white messy short hair with a faint pink cast, thick fluffy bangs, strands flying outward with strong linear rhythm. Huge bright-orange round glasses with a clear fisheye magnification; through the lenses, large clear teal-green eyes, dense expressive lashes, slightly raised brows, a small nose, pale pink blush and a few freckles with comic hatching. Her mouth is wide open in a sudden comic surprise or excited laugh — pink tongue, neat white teeth, dark interior — dramatic but not sexualized. The face is pushed extremely close to the camera.

OUTFIT: a bright lemon-yellow oversized hooded sweatshirt, heavy fabric folds with hand-drawn black ink lines. One huge sleeve or arm reaches straight toward the lens in the foreground, in a high-contrast black-and-white checkerboard pattern, creating strong occlusion and exaggerated near-far scale. Yellow hood and Harajuku street-sport details. Fully clothed.

LENS AND COMPOSITION: extreme close-up, as if the lens is almost touching her face; 180-degree fisheye, strong barrel distortion, dramatic foreshortening. Head tilts toward the right; the face sits on a bold diagonal in the center; the left foreground is dominated by the giant yellow sleeve and checkerboard cloth. Glasses, eyes, nose and open mouth are the focus. Hair arcs up and to the right. Face, shoulder and foreground fabric overlap for immersive depth.

BACKGROUND: a large field of vivid coral-orange-red, with cream-white, black and lemon-yellow bold geometric blocks — irregular tilted rectangles, sharp cuts, abstract flat shapes, like an experimental Japanese fashion-magazine cover. A little black ink spatter, vintage print noise, and paper grain. In the lower right, a striking black geometric zone may hold a short invented word in yellow retro type; prefer the cleaner typography variant, or drop the letters if they are garbled. No real magazine titles, no brand logos, no watermarks.

CRAFT AND COLOR: mixed vintage Japanese manga and contemporary commercial illustration. Fine hand-inked black lines of uneven thickness, rhythmic hair hatching, dense short strokes for eye sockets, lashes, brows, nose, cheek, jaw and neck. Clean 2D hard-edge flat cel shading, minimal gradients, crisp black outlines, bold graphic shapes. Palette: coral red-orange, lemon yellow, cream white, pink-white skin, teal-green eyes, bright orange glasses, deep black ink. Almost no photographic lighting or soft 3D volume.

The whole frame is 16:9 widescreen, edge to edge, ultra-sharp 2D comic illustration, strong near-camera impact.

items.title: 极简纸艺插画上下海报（3:4 · 编辑体文字）
items.aspectNote: 源条目 3:4，Imagine 用 2:3 Poster。生成前确认已切回 2:3 Poster。
items.imaginePrompt:
A vertical 2:3 high-end editorial poster strictly split 50/50 top and bottom, a clean straight horizontal join, no frames, tape, or blend. Invent one complete scene — do not ask for a reference photo.

TOP HALF: a photoreal photograph, exhibition / editorial grade, of a fully clothed adult woman in a cream knit sweater sitting on a sunlit wooden park bench under a plane tree, a closed book on her lap, golden-hour light, quiet and refined. Preserve the face, pose, clothing and objects faithfully. Subtle premium grading.

BOTTOM HALF: the SAME scene turned into a small minimalist handmade paper illustration, centered in a large field of warm-white negative space — never fill the lower half. Simple acrylic-style colors, imperfect brush lines and visible paper texture. Use at most four colors taken from the photo (cream, bark-brown, leaf-green, soft gold). Below the illustration, add minimal elegant editorial typography: a short emotional title related to the moment, plus a tiny subtitle, in a handwritten / modern art-book style — for example “Held Light” and “a bench, a book, an hour.” Prefer the cleaner typography variant; if lettering is messy, choose the cleaner one.

Mood: quiet, poetic, refined, innocent, premium art-book. No cartoon, no crayon, no watercolor, no 3D, no glossy digital art, no busy decoration, no logos or watermarks. Distinct from a food-illustration poster, a sparse marker doodle, and a creamy impasto still life.

items.title: 朦胧几何插画上下海报（鼠尾草绿 · 3:4）
items.imaginePrompt:
A vertical 2:3 comparison poster of one invented scene — do not ask for a reference photo. This is not a hard flush 50/50 split: the upper photograph should fill the top and the left and right edges, with a clearly visible cream-white band in the middle whose edges fade softly, forming a leftover-white transition. No hard frames.

TOP: a photoreal photograph of a quiet mountain lake at dawn, dark pines, a small wooden pier reaching into still water, soft mist, cool natural light.

BOTTOM: the SAME scene restaged as a hazy geometric illustration. Keep the subject, viewpoint and main composition. Distill the complex scenery into a few large rounded volumes; do not add unrelated objects. Palette: sage green, grey-green, deep forest green and cream white, with a little warm apricot. Soft gradients for volume, plus a fine matte grain. Strengthen creamy fog-light so the distance, the bases of forms, and the edges of the frame melt into mist; contours half-seen, the main subject still recognizable. Large-scale simplification, with only a little fine plant or subject detail. The lower area should melt naturally into the cream-white ground, with generous leftover space. On the right, one short vertical line of grey Chinese related to the scene, such as 「雾尚未散」. Prefer the cleaner characters; drop the type if it is wrong or messy.

Overall mood: quiet, airy, soft. No hard edges, no harsh contrast, no plastic look, no dense detail, no logos or watermarks. Distinct from a large-block geometric deconstruction poster and from a tiny teal riso silhouette.

items.title: 复古装饰插画海报（雾霾蓝 65% · 3:4）
items.aspectNote: 源条目 3:4，Imagine 用 2:3 Poster。这不是上下 50/50 双联，而是满铺装饰插画，右下角留一小张原图。
items.imaginePrompt:
A single full-bleed vertical 2:3 vintage decorative-illustration poster — NOT a 50/50 diptych. Invent one complete scene — do not ask for a reference photo.

The illustration fills the whole poster. In the lower-right corner, keep one small photoreal inset of the same scene, about 20 percent of the poster width, with unaltered photographic texture.

SCENE (used for both the illustration and the inset): a quiet morning tea table by a window — a ceramic teapot, two cups, a plate of citrus, a folded linen cloth, soft daylight. Extract the most recognizable subjects, trim clutter, and rearrange scale, overlap and edge-crop for a clear hierarchy.

STYLE: about 65 percent haze blue (雾霾蓝), with cream yellow, sage green and off-white, all matte flat color, no gradients and no 3D lighting. Shapes are natural, irregular, planar. Fine slightly wavering hand-drawn lines, plus veins, stripes, checks or dots that follow the forms; dense pattern alternates with solid color fields. The blue ground may hold fine dots or grouped vertical dashed lines. Short English in cream-yellow vintage serif capitals, loosely tracked, a title and a few staggered lines that sit in the gaps — for example “MORNING TEA” and “BLUE HOUR TABLE.” Prefer the cleaner typography variant, or less type if messy.

The whole should feel like a soft vintage color-print, with a slight handmade quality. No heavy outlines, no heavy grain, no unrelated flowers, no logos or watermarks. Distinct from an oil-pastel still life and from a food-illustration diptych.

items.title: 几何母题拓印海报（上下 1:1 · 木刻丝网）
items.aspectNote: 源条目 3:4，Imagine 用 2:3 Poster。标题里的「上下 1:1」是指竖版里上下各占 50%，不要切到 1:1 Square。
items.imaginePrompt:
A vertical 2:3 design poster strictly split 50/50 top and bottom — the source “1:1” means equal halves, not a square canvas. Invent one complete scene — do not ask for a reference photo. No frames, collage shadows, or logos.

TOP HALF: a photoreal photograph of a traditional oil-paper umbrella hanging under the wooden eaves of a covered corridor after rain, wet cobblestones below, one lantern, quiet natural light. Keep the subject, pose, proportions, real texture, light and original color, with only subtle editorial grading. Do not recrop away the umbrella or invent a new composition.

BOTTOM HALF: a large field of warm-white textured paper. From the same umbrella extract one core visual motif, built on a rigorous geometric skeleton of circles, radiating ribs, arcs and axes. Reconstruct it as a graphic that feels like a folk catalog plate, an ancient rubbing, and modern flat design at once — silhouette, negative space, a slightly enlarged fragment, merged forms, symbolic translation. Do not literally transcribe every photo element, and do not pile on generic traditional ornaments.

Color taken from the photo: one dark ink for structure, one or two theme colors, and a little accent. Mixed woodcut rubbing, dry-brush silkscreen, and old catalog print: broken ink, wipe marks, paper showing through, slight registration shift, but important contours and geometric edges must stay clear. Generous leftover white. A short Chinese title and one small English caption as supporting type only, for example 「油纸伞」 and “ribs, rain, returning.” Prefer the cleaner typography variant.

Mood: meaning first, restrained graphics, strict geometry, coarse rubbing, fresh color, clear leftover space. Not a linocut full-scene restyle, not a postage stamp, not a realistic illustration, not a collage. No watermarks.

items.title: 包豪斯抽象几何重构海报（上下 1:1 · Risograph）
items.aspectNote: 源条目 3:4，Imagine 用 2:3 Poster。「上下 1:1」仍是竖版 50/50，不要切到 1:1 Square。下半禁止矩形和方块网格。
items.imaginePrompt:
A vertical 2:3 poster strictly split 50/50 top and bottom, a clean straight horizontal join, no frames, cards, tape, torn paper, or collage shadows. Invent one complete scene — do not ask for a reference photo.

TOP HALF: a photoreal photograph of a fully clothed adult woman in a navy wool coat standing on a windy seaside cliff, a pale scarf blowing, grey-blue sea and pale sky behind her, late-afternoon light. Keep her face, hair, clothing, pose, the environment, composition, materials, depth and color; only subtle grading is allowed. No watermarks or extra objects.

BOTTOM HALF: a thorough Bauhaus / Swiss experimental / vintage independent-magazine / Risograph reconstruction of the SAME moment. No leftover photographic region, not a filter, not geometry laid over a photo. STRICTLY no rectangles, squares, block collage, checkerboards, rectangular grids, or right-angle frames made of lines. Use only circles, half-circles, rings, arcs, sectors, ellipses, triangles, wedges, cones, crescents, irregular curves, open contours, gaps, thin straight lines, dotted lines, curves, nodes, dots, trajectories and negative space. Every form must come from the photo (the blowing scarf, the cliff edge, the sun, a bird, her stance).

Shrink the core geometric cluster to about 30 percent of the lower half so it sits as a refined concentrated center, slightly off-axis if needed, with a large field of warm-white / ivory leftover paper around it. Colors taken from the photo, mostly tonal shifts in one family; no cheap gradients, neon, or noisy high saturation.

Add a meaningful 1-to-4-word English art title plus a little supporting English index or number, in a thin high-contrast Didot / Bodoni / Didone serif, freely and asymmetrically placed — for example “WINDWARD” and a small “No. 12.” Prefer the cleaner typography variant; if letters are garbled, choose the cleaner one or less type. A few thin lines, open arcs, dots and nodes may connect the cluster to the leftover field. Fine warm paper fiber, slight Risograph grain, and mild registration shift, but type and lines stay sharp.

Distinct from a large rectangular-block deconstruction, from a woodcut-rubbing motif plate, and from an isometric architectural sand-table. No logos or watermarks.

items.title: 吐槽贴纸插画（上下 3:4 · 钴蓝明黄）
items.imaginePrompt:
A vertical 2:3 poster strictly split 50/50 top and bottom, a clean straight horizontal join, no blend, fade, or elements crossing the divide. Invent one complete scene — do not ask for a reference photo.

TOP HALF: an unaltered-looking photoreal photograph of a fluffy orange tabby cat loafing on a sunlit wooden floor, completely relaxed, editorial pet photography, natural light.

BOTTOM HALF: a humorous commentary sticker illustration of the SAME cat, filling the lower half as one white die-cut sticker with a visible kiss-cut edge. Translate the cat into a simple cartoon: round head, minimal features, exaggerated body, same loafing pose and calm mood. Thick even black marker outlines; loose doodle accents such as short hatch, motion lines or sweat drops. Large flat color fills, no gradients and no realistic shading. High-saturation cobalt blue as the main color, lemon yellow as the accent, black line, white ground; bright clash, no grey or murky tones.

Composition: an arched title banner at the top of the sticker with a short English jab of 3 to 6 words, such as “Just Another Lazy Day!”; the cat in the center; around it 3 to 5 small elements (clouds, stars, or tiny floating objects) that contrast with the cat’s calm, each no larger than one-third of the cat. No typography anywhere except the banner title. Do not copy UFOs, rainclouds, or ice cubes. Not a realistic rendering, not an ugly-cute mascot restyle of a shiba, not a sparse editorial doodle. No watermarks or signatures.
